interface.name: kestrel_window_manager_v1
interface.description:
Lets a client keep a toplevel out of the desktop's window lists, such as the taskbar and the window switcher, and keep it above other windows. Palettes, launchers and tray popups use these. Sandboxed clients do not see this global.
From version 2, the compositor lets people resize a toplevel that draws nothing outside its window geometry from just outside its edges, so such clients need no resize area of their own over their content.

entry.name: already_requested
entry.summary: the toplevel already has a window state object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroying the manager leaves window state objects it created intact.

request.name: get_window_state

description.summary: get the window state object of a toplevel

request.description: Creates the window state object of a toplevel. A toplevel can have only one; asking again is an already_requested error.

interface.name: kestrel_window_state_v1
interface.description: Requests take effect immediately and last until they are undone or the object is destroyed, which returns the toplevel to its default state. The toplevel keeps the state when it is unmapped and mapped again.

description.summary: return the toplevel to its default state

request.name: set_skip_window_list

description.summary: leave the toplevel out of window lists

request.description: The toplevel no longer appears in the taskbar, the window switcher or other lists of windows.

description.summary: show the toplevel in window lists again
keep the toplevel above other windows
